notes: No European or Israeli 2018-2020 (JF81) PCX125 owner's manual could be retrieved. Honda Motopub Europe lists PCX125 manuals only from 2021, and ManualsLib and hondapcx.org are Cloudflare-blocked. Two official manuals of the same generation disagree by market: Korea 2019 (6,000 km grid) and Turkey 2018 JF81 (4,000 km grid, oil every 2,000 km / 6 months). The Philippine PCX150 2019 manual (149 cc sister) matches Korea exactly. These are separate national Honda documents from the same template, so they are not fully independent publishers. The 2021 EU PCX125 manual (next generation) uses the 6,000 km grid; that is context only. All chart intervals were read from tick-mark positions on rendered pages; the quotes give the row label plus legend/column text, and the locators give the ticked columns. Honda charts have an 'Annual Check' column: oil is marked R there in the KR/PH manuals, hence 12 months. Severe-use notes with no numbers: air cleaner *2 'service more frequently when riding in unusually wet or dusty areas'; crankcase breather *3 'rain or full throttle'. The drive belt (replace 24,000 km, inspect 12,000 km), final drive oil (2 years), brake fluid (2 years) and coolant (3 years) agree across all sources. Recommendation: confirm with the Israeli importer or an EU 2018-2020 manual before choosing between the 6,000 km and 4,000 km grids.
